findings: FileManager.moveFile directly renameTo destination basename with no collision/physical-identity check, rollback or cross-device copy fallback. Actual overwrite behavior depends on platform and was not executed.

moveFolderContents accepts source/destination without equality or descendant checks, treats listFiles null as empty, and attempts source deletion even in that case. Delete result ignored; returns success counts. pathsToScan is collected but never submitted in this method.

convertVideoToImage opens sibling basename.jpg with FileOutputStream, overwriting any existing image without collision handling. It ignores Bitmap.compress boolean result and has no temporary-file/atomic replacement or rollback. No conversion or file overwrite executed.
MediaMetadataRetriever.release is not in finally in convertVideoToImage, and extracted bitmap is not explicitly recycled. Failure paths can bypass release; Android resource effects unmeasured.

scanPaths waits only for calling MediaScannerConnection.scanFile on Main, not its completion callbacks. createMediaItemFromFile immediately queries MediaStore and may fall back to file URI; this is not guaranteed finished indexing.

Tree URI conversion splits document IDs on every colon and takes only element one, potentially dropping later colon-containing path content. Nonprimary storage is explicitly unsupported by this helper.
